notes.title: Update 1.22.2
notes.notes:
We figured it was time to fix a couple of outstanding things in Inevitability and bring the game engine and framework up to date so here is an update :) 

Even though this game is 6 years old at this point we still would love to hear any bugs you find and fix them! We don't plan on adding more features to Inevitability beyond bug fixes however given enough demand that could always change (or If I just get that itch) ;) Let us know if you run into any issues!

We have been working on other games in the Inevitability universe and if you haven't checked out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289750/Operation_Zeta/]Operation Zeta [/url]yet you should!

As always thanks for the continued support!

[h1] Patch notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new [url=https://www.patreon.com/SfsStudios]Patreon [/url] Names
[*] Updated to newest Version of FreakingSweet (Our game engine) (tons of bugs got fixed due to this)
[*] Updated to .NET Framework version 4.5.2
[*] Fixed a ton of grammatical errors and typos.
[*] Fixed bug that wouldn't save progress on crafting/trading parts quests
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.22: Engine Updates and New Game!
notes.notes:
Hey guys It is the five year anniversary of Inevitability on Steam!! We have been reworking and improving our own custom engine that Inevitability runs on.

The reason behind this is because we have a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289750/Operation_Zeta/]new game in the Inevitability universe that has just released[/url] called Operation Zeta.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9790064/9cb1c015ccd981360384dd2d882d3c86b4424115.gif[/img]

Overall you should see improvements many things such as sound effects, fluidity of animations and general performance improvements to the game. Thank you guys for all the support and love you guys have given Inevitability the past five years! Ful(ish) patch notes are below. 

[h1]1.22.0[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Patreon supporter names to random NPCS
[*] Upgraded FreakingSweet to newest version.
[*] Changed how the game handles animation to be way more performant
[*] Fixed Sound glitches when having multiple of the same sound effect
[*] Fixed some weirdness around mouse and key inputs
[*] Fixed a ton of other small graphical and text glitches.
[/list]

[h1]1.22.1[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added [url=https://www.patreon.com/SfsStudios]patreon [/url]names/credits
[*] Upgraded FreakingSweet to newest version.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.21 New Race, Two new factions & more
notes.notes:
Hey guys sorry for the delay in the update we have been working hard on our new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661500/Rekindling/]Rekindling[/url] as well as working on a secret project for the Inevitability universe.. Anyways 1.21 is a pretty large content update!

[h1] New Race[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9790064/c18d9f595f742239734c67cd5e5213b640e60ec0.png[/img]
There is a new race! The Roki. They are a small crafty rat like species. They are found often as cheaper mechanics on large ships or mercenaries flying around the universe.

[h1] Two new factions[/h1]
With the addition of the Roki we have added two new factions exclusive to the Roki. Mercenary and the Rokun. Each comes with their own quest line, special abilities, as well new Steam achievements!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9790064/2897194f8f2ba36794399ec344fc8b143f63cb11.png[/img]

[h1] Other Features and improvements [/h1]
We have added other user requested features such as *finally* being able to shoot Mika worms. As well we have made a number of graphical improvements from redoing from scratch how the star background looked to making it so the character portraits are only what you will see in the headshot
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9790064/43c50c34b8b419441927868acfe7d63632af54fa.gif[/img]


[h1] Other fun Inevitability related news & final thoughts [/h1]
We have a [url=https://discord.gg/aRY78BU]Discord for Inevitability[/url] now! Its a good place to give feedback quickly to me as well as talk about cool ship designs and strategy! 

I mentioned earlier that there are fun things in store for the universe of Inevitability in the near future. If you haven't been following us, I am now doing game development as a full time job and have a lot of fun things in the pipeline. If you want to see more from us in general feel free to support us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/SfsStudios]Patreon[/url] and see your name in the game and get early access to those new Inevitability things.

As always please leave us feedback here, on discord or as a Review on Steam. We want to keep making things better and you guys are the best way to do that! Full(ish) patch notes below.

[h1] 1.21.0 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new Race: Roki
[*] Added new Faction: Rokun
[*] Added new Faction: Mercenary
[*] Added Patreon supporter names as stars and to the Credits
[*] Added discord button on homescreen
[*] Added crash reporting windows when a crash happens
[*] Added the ability to shoot mika worms
[*] Upgraded to newest Version of Freaking Sweet engine
[*] Changed Star backdrop to be prettier and smoother
[*] Changed some click bounding on pause menu to be less weird
[*] Changed some Sukinina quests to be not so punishing
[*] Changed race/faction descriptions
[*] Changed character portrait to just be the headshot
[*] Fixed a ton of small graphical issues with things being out of place on larger resolutions
[*] Fixed some text overlaps with the quest menu
[*] Fixed some grammatical mistakes in a ton of places.
[/list]

[h1] 1.21.1 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new Patron names to credits and race names
[*] Updated FreakingSweet to newest version
[/list]

notes.title: 1.20.4 Update & Announcements
notes.notes:
Hey guys small update just went out that fixed some assorted bugs and upgraded Inevitability to use the latest version of our custom game Engine (FreakingSweet). Overall some crashes are now fixed and lot of small usability things have changed.

In other news we have plans for a large update for Inevitability before the year is over! We have been focused heavily on Updates for our newer game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661500/Rekindling/]Rekindling[/url] but that doesn't mean we can't have some fun things in store for Inevitability  as well... stay tuned!! 

As always let us know any feedback you have or if you have any questions!

notes.title: 1.20 Update is out. Science! Science! Science!
notes.notes:
Hey guys It has been awhile. We have a cool update that just went out that added a long requested feature of being able to research new parts.
You can see all the parts you have researched already and research new ones from the new research menu by spending "research points". You can get research points from the new part type of labs that can go on stations to generate passive science points. Even without labs you will slowly get points over time.

[h1]OH BOY SCIENCE [/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9790064/96904671c9b4add6e7558473862bc7296814f6a5.png[/img]

We have changed a lot on the backend of Inevitability, most of it is unnoticeable as we have improved our game engine for our second game that is just now entering early access on Steam. (you should check it out its pretty cool)

[h1]1.20[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added research menu!
    [*]Added new part type: Labs.
    [*]Changed background image as it was very small and you could see the tiling.
[*]Fixed bunch of font issues with sizing and placement.
[*]Fixed you being able to make broken saves from the tutorial.
[*]Fixed Tech parts not saying what they do.
[*]Fixed Bug with parts rotating. This mainly effected the blue laser.
[*]Upgraded to the latest Version of Freaking Sweet (our game engine).
[/list]

notes.title: 1.19.0 update is out. Looks a bit better!
notes.notes:
New update is out!!!

This post will be a short one as there isn't large things just tons of little things.

Some highlights.....


The fonts have been made more consistent! 
Fonts and a lot of the UI was pretty inconsistent in places so we have made strides to make them more consistent. Such as having the same font/coloring across the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9790064/d47c853f738a4e34139a1ec168cb2697c071346a.png[/img]

Throughout the game things that made it feel choppy and styles inconstant have been changed to be more consistent and smooth. Such as there being a proper loading screen after the intro if the world doesn't finish loading by the end of it, Or the actual dirt explosions on the planet matching the color of the dirt. Or your probe studdering when going diagonally. 

On a more technical front lots of old gross and clunky code has been moved.
The update will actually make your game file folder size about 30mb smaller because of the cleanup of unnecessary files and code running. 

Thanks everyone for sticking with us and continuing to enjoy our game!

notes.title: Update went out and update on development!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Update has just gone out.

[b]*Update that just went out*[/b]
It is a small update from a download perspective, but under the hood a whole ton has changed. Big things like lasers producing significantly more lag than they should, or the game being slow when exiting and reloading a save multiple times and the game window being off screen with multiple monitor setups are just a few of the things you will notice right away that are fixed. Smaller things such as UI helpers and more standardization on Fonts and colors in places will also be apparent. 

[b]*Nerdy tech things*[/b]
From a more technical perspective we updated our graphics library and updated to be targeting a newer version of the .NET framework 

[b]*Game update*[/b]
I can't be thankful enough for those who have supported Inevitability the past four years! Last update I gave you guys I said we would be getting updates out more frequently sadly this has not happened so far. Things have come up that have slowed development and that is on me (I am indeed a one man dev). However I want to start ramping up again and giving at least some form of an update every monthish. If that is some new UI improvements or bigger features such as the new research system we have planned or suggestions from the forums (We love these and they normally happen before other things ;) ).

Again I  thank all of you for the support you have given us and hope to get in the future! As always feel free to ask us if you have any questions.

notes.title: 1.17 Update! And quick road-map for Summer updates
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9790064/ad7910acb77008f81a43a825ff909feadf5fb315.png[/img]

[b][u]New update is out![/u][/b]
Major points of this new update are UI additions and back-end improvements.
There are now additional UI buttons on all of the screens to help navigate between different game states.

Other parts of the HUD have also been upgraded to look nicer and to be easier to read in general. 

The back-end for Quests and station interaction has changed significantly, this is in preparation for some cool stuff coming later this month.

This summer we will cranking out a major updates more frequently than we usually do. Also with future updates, it will be more clear as to what will be in them and when they are coming before it happens.

[b][u]Here is what we have on the docket for the next couple Updates:[/u][/b]
1.17: Side Quests, Faction Switching 
1.18: New Faction, Mod-able Factions/quests.
1.19: Research System, New part Type: Labs

As always if you guys have something you want to see in these updates let us know, and it will most likely sneak its way in (Check out the update forums, most of the ideas posted there have made it in, in some form)

Thanks as always for the continued support from you guys!

notes.title: 1.16 Update and some real talk.
notes.notes:
[b][u]1.16 Update[/u][/b]
Hey guys the 1.16 update has just gone out! It's our largest update file-size wise since the launch! 

A lot of the background music has been reworked to be less repetitive and overall just better. As well more sound effects have been added to make things sound more exciting and diverse.
 
More textures have been reworked to make the overall game prettier.

The beef of the update however is with stability and bug fix improvements. Too many here to list but overall the experience should be better overall.

However if we missed anything there is now a log folder in your game that will fill out a crash log whenever a crash happens. Let us know about this in the forms and it will be fixed within 48 hours!

[b][u]Real Talk[/u][/b]
Anyways time for the real talk. As you guys may have seen our review score has plummeted recently. It is honestly discouraging when that happens, but I wanted to assure you guys that we read ALL of the feedback that is given (we read it a lot of times too) and try incorporate it into making Inevitability better. 

Make sure to tell us what you dislike/like about Inevitability so we can make it overall a better experience for you guys :)  Much of what has been suggested for features has found its way into the game in some manner. 

Also a shout out to the people who give us productive feedback and support! You guys are what keep us going! 

We have some cool stuff planned for this summer for long requested big features, excited to see you guys dive into it!

notes.title: 1.15 Update! New parts, lots of other stuff.
notes.notes:
Lots of stuff has been added and improved in the 1.15 update.

Here are some of the highlights:

[b] Build menu and part changes/additions[/b]

[i] New part type: Ramming Weapons[/i]
Ramming weapons will do extra damage on impact and give you another way to tackle combat.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9790064/ddb5adf132a1fa2a70530568e660386da22410d3.gif[/img] 
[i] New part type: Batteries[/i]
Batteries are introduced to make power management more interesting for planning of ships. They are able to store extra power.

Ship cores now have a part limit. Better cores allow you to attach more parts to them. Be careful on old saves as older ships with weaker cores will not be able to be relaunched with all of their parts.

Parts in the game now have information about them! Such as something unique that that part does, or where it was originated in the lore. A description of the part type is also here. You get info on parts by pressing I while you have it selected in the build menu.

Parts also will now auto-craft if you try to build with them and you are out of crafted ones.

[b]Ship / Planetary system updates[/b]

All ships are now equipped with a display that will show the faction and captain of the nearest ship. It also says how much they like you of course! [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9790064/16778591578976b7735632f579c9f29a069e862f.gif[/img]

The Planetary systems are now twice as large as they were before!

[b]Misc[/b]
You can now have unlimited named saves instead of just the save games 1,2,3. You old saves will automatically be migrated to the new save system. 

A bunch of other bugfixes and optimizations have been made, the game should now preform significantly better with large amounts of lasers on the map at once.  

If you want to play an older version for whatever reason you can access it through the properties in your Games Library.

notes.title: 1.14 Update. New mining mechanics!
notes.notes:
The 1.14 update is finally out.
Significant performance improvements on planets as well as a revamp of how mining works. Also there are smaller improvements in performance on most other areas of the game. Major changes are summarized below. 

[b]Mining[/b] 
[list]
[*]Added health and heat to probes.
[*]Probes will heat up with contiuned use and need to vent to cool down (seen below with an updated HUD)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9790064/b864e6ca36c68d4d56820aa65ede2ba4f001499b.png[/img]
[*]Probes now lose fewer minerals on contact with Worms, but now take damage. They will lose a significant amount of minerals if their health drops to 0. You can heal your probe at the base on each planet
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9790064/c81662b5e6ce3e26b7a7e8b0d0e1c5018171e0ce.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]Building/Flying[/b] 
[list]
[*]Fuel tanks have been removed and engines now only use power
[*]Improvements to the build menu display UI. 
[*]Improved performance of lasers and ship collisions. 
[/list]

Lastly a moment of silence for all of the bugs that have been squashed in the making of this update...

notes.title: Anniversary Update. 1.13
notes.notes:
It has been a year since we have launched on Steam! Don't worry we aren't going anywhere Inevitability will keep getting updates into the foreseeable future, more on that at the bottom!

This update is mostly a massive back-end overhaul. So most changes are improved performance speeds, far less bugs and faster development times on our end. However with that being said we managed to get some cool new stuff in :) 

Firstly, we have improved the targeting mechanic. If you have no targeted ships your ship will now auto target the nearest ship. The targeting UI has also been changed to be animated.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9790064/2a996f174d210c8fe2a1df14c7cbc0a8bb283910.png[/img]

Your mining probe now has built in scanners that can be upgraded to see enemy's or minerals! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9790064/fd045a79854ab08033499e693f62e472f420eeb1.png[/img]

[b]Side Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Development in general has shifted to be more incremental so if you haven't played since the release of 1.12.0 there is a ton of other new stuff as well that came out in later 1.12 versions! 

[*]We have a lot of exciting UI changes and mechanic balances that should make the game easier to understand and more enjoyable for the coming weeks!  

[*]Saves from before the 1.11 update that where played and saved on the 1.12 update may be messed up, due to a bug in 1.12. If you have any save that won't load send it to us (thesfsstudios@gmail.com) and we can fix it ASAP!   

[*] As always we love suggestions from our community, and nearly all of what has been in recent updates is from you guys! Keep it coming and thank you so much for sticking with us!! 

[/list]

This is the first part in a two part update to help you guys share the cool stuff you guys are doing and making in Inevitability! 

Part two will come in the coming weeks with workshop support, improved AI and a multiplayer arena of sorts!

Also Steam Trading cards will come sometime in the next week.
(Update: It is taking longer than expected to get some of them drawn. Expect them with 1.12 :) ) 

Enjoy the update and let me know what other stats you guys would like to see on the stats page!

[img]http://nebula.wsimg.com/2abe7c7bf68525225e8f735fe61e0552?AccessKeyId=CDDFBB33BD91E0AEE904&disposition=0&alloworigin=1[/img]

notes.title: 1.10.6 Update and special announcements
notes.notes:
Hey friends the 1.10.6 update just came out today that fixed some bugs that people where having with negative mineral counts. Some other bugs that I found hiding also got squished.

[b]First[/b] of all I have big news for us as a company. Our second game has just gone up on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=634316224] Greenlight![/url] [b]Now wait[/b], do not jump ship and panic thinking "this means that this is the end of Inevitability". Our new game has been in development for the past year and a half so it has already been happening alongside Inevitability as they both use parts of an game engine that we built. You can read about how that whole process all worked with Inevitability on a [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/gamedev/comments/3pwum1/inevitability_postmortem_and_my_gamedev/]rant I did on Reddit awhile back[/url] if you are interested.

[b]Now[/b] for some Inevitability news! The 1.11/1.12 updates are planned to come out early-mid April and has some really cool new stuff in it such as the long awaited randomly generated side quests. Along with this the enemy ship AI is getting a massive overhaul, The reason for that is something exciting... An arena mode! 
Ships in the 1.12 update will function as Steam workshop items that you can download from the community page and pit them against each other to see who has designed the best ship.
 We have some fun competitions and battle live-streams planned with this and some really cool prizes to give out to the best ship makers.

See you guys soon, I think it is Inevitable ;) !

notes.title: 1.10 Update. Mining improvements, Bigger parts, Zoom fixes, and much more!
notes.notes:
The 1.10 update has just gone out! In this update we tried to address as many of your ideas as possible and put them into the game.

The first thing that you can notice is that mining is a whole new ball game. All of the planet textures have been redone and are no longer blocky. The planets are 10 times bigger, you can now upgrade your probe to mine better, you can find secret parts in the planet, and there are worms wandering in each planet to nab your minerals!

Another highly requested feature was the ability to zoom in/out when you are flying your ship around, and it has been added. On top of that the menus have been reworked to fit better on all resolutions.

Many new parts have been added including some new 2x1 parts that have two systems in a single part! 

This update is by far jam packed with the most new content since the launch on Steam, let us know what you think of it!

Community ships uploaded from 1.8.1 update and above will be slowly added over the next week. We got a lot of them the past two months and are still sorting through them. 

[b]1.10.0 Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 7 new parts
[*] Increased planet size by 10
[*] Added upgrade-able probe features
[*] Added Mika worms on the planet that hit you and take minerals
[*] Added zoom feature to the ship view
[*] Added new element on planets to give you new secret parts
[*] Fixed sometimes spawning on enemies when warping into a new system
[*] Fixed scaling issues with the menus on high resolutions
[*] Fixed some typos in tutorials
[*] Fixed Tractor beam control mappings not working for planet and ship
[*] Fixed some other minor sound bugs
[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.0 Update (Wait there was just an update!?!?)
notes.notes:
The 1.9 update is here and you may be asking questions such as "didn't the 1.8 update just come out" And "there was an update yesterday?!" 

Well we have had a major change in the works for awhile, moving the Framework that Inevitability runs on to be something more modern. It is stable enough now and this update solves far more problems than it creates so we decided to release it early :)  

This however doesn't change our schedule and the 1.10.0 Update with some really cool new content will be out late January/Early February.

The actual change log of fixes is extremely massive so i'll just give you the highlights here.

[list]
[*]Moved from entire codebase from XNA to MonoGame (WHEW)
[*]Fixed XNA Sound bug with it leaving ghost processes 
[*]Fixed Occasional graphics bugs of animated textures not appearing
[*]Fixed the mapping from the last update for some of the controls
[*]Fixed some annoying gamepad bugs 
[*]Fixed save compatibility with Save files all the way back to Version 1.2
[*]Fixed so many other XNA related bugs
[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.0 update! Hipoom Incoming.
notes.notes:
[h1]GALACTIC NEWS[/h1]

As the industrial Ukinkina faction grows ever stronger in the galaxy some members of the United Space Federation have taken action into their own hands. Their goal is to stop USF corruption by the Ukinkina.This comes after Ukinkina's blatant disregard for the well being of the environment and inhabitants on the planet of Zuol. These free-lance protesters are calling themselves the Hipoom.  

The Reta-Leziua have been hard at work designing new parts for ships. Their most recent breakthrough has been in spin thrusters to help large ships spin around with ease. They have also made all lasers less explosive while doing the same impact so you can see your target's last moments.
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CUe0b6yUEAAkgS-.png:large [/img]
The Pesomila faction, in their eternal pursuit of peace and zen in the universe, have equipped every ship and station with sound modulation units. This now helps everyone hear more pleasing sounds when doing virtually everything.

The Ukinkina outraged by the birth of the Hipoom Faction are pledging increased mining in USF Space and are rumored to be on the hunt for an external faction to help with the new threat..



[b]1.8 update Full Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Hipoom Faction and quest-line
[*]Added 9 new parts and 2 new sub-types
[*]Added Community ships uploaded from 8-2-15 ~ 12-1-15
[*]Changed nearly all sound effects and made them more varied
[*]Changed some of the art for the HUD to make quests more clear
[*]Changed font for much of the in-game text to make it more readable
[*]Changed some of the relationship algorithms to make it more balanced
[*]Changed a lot the action animations
[*]Fixed "phantom ships" from appearing
[*]Fixed some ship loading bugs for enemies
[*]Fixed load times across the board(it is now almost instant for some things)
[*]Fixed Lag caused with a large amount of beam lasers
[*]Fixed some layering issues with quests
[*]Fixed the mouse bugging out in the character menu
[*]Fixed bug with parts when attempting to rotate certain objects
[*]Fixed Ship light layering on certain parts.
[*]Fixed a whole ton of other very minor things
[/list]

notes.title: The "Flow update" is out.
notes.notes:
The "Flow Update" for Inevitability is finally here. This update addresses many issues players were having with the game. Overall the game is more balanced and flows more from beginning to end.

Much of the confusing UI has been reworked and is now more clear. The UI is also more mouse and controller friendly. As well the tutorial has been expanded to make the learning curve for the game not so difficult.

Some of the community ships that you guys have been uploading via the build menu have also been put in the game.

Last big thing is there is a new part type: Point Defense Turrets that will shoot down incoming projectiles and drones. [i] Seen below[/i]

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CPkkUjHWUAAkm_Y.png[/img]

[b] FULL CHANGE LOG[/b]
[list]
[*] Added select community ships uploaded from 8/24/15 - 9/20/15
[*] Added new part type: point defense laser
[*] Added HUD prompts for many aspects of moving around the world and menus
[*] Added Extended Tutorial for mining and building ships
[*] Added a ton of mouse support in the build menu
[*] Updated Build menu art to be more informative
[*] Updated Build menu to fully work with mouse only controls
[*] Updated Enemy Ship AI to be more mobile in combat
[*] Updated Drone AI to be more random and dangerous
[*] Updated Drone Spawn Time for all DroneCores (they are all longer)
[*] Updated Text Overlay background.
[*] Fixed Invisible drone bug
[*] Fixed Unlimited stacking bug
[*] Fixed a couple menu bugs that could get the user stuck
[*] Fixed some other minor graphical bugs
[/list]

Thanks for all the support you guys. I look forward to seeing what cool ships come from you guys next!!
